column1: # Reconstructed 2026-10-12 from the fire research agent's fetch commands and their "ok <path> <bytes>" echoes. Columns: local path, pinned URL, licence as recorded, bytes fetched ("-" where no echo was seen). 65 of the report's 80-81 sources; missing: the VS Code, Zed and W3C conversions.js files and the Apple documentation JSONs, whose fetch commands used shell variables this reconstruction could not resolve. Every SHA-256 is lost.
